name: llm-wiki
description: A self-maintaining knowledge base that lives in a folder. Guided setup, scheduled ingest, a daily brief, and reports on the topics your role is accountable for.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: Self-maintaining knowledge base for a folder. One guided setup builds the wiki structure, wires your connectors, writes the folder's CLAUDE.md so questions and ingests route automatically, and creates three scheduled jobs: daily ingest, daily brief, monthly lint. No CLI, no repository, no install for teammates — sharing the folder shares the wiki.
